integrity: Proof reconstructed from Ore evaluation and cyclic group norm, complemented by independently implemented finite checks; infinite claims rest on proof, not brute force. No external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Right roots only in the coefficient field of a quadratic extension; q odd; no higher-degree factorization, no left roots. Case n=1 is background. Full text of the Tsushima 2026 Zenodo preprint was inaccessible, creating an originality risk for possible subgroup refinements.
title: Complete right-root spectra of Frobenius skew trinomials over quadratic finite fields
